parsed.explanation: No explicit criminalisation, entry restriction or facility ban for trans visitors; supportive official posture, administrative recognition, health-system coverage and a court ruling protecting sexual-minority spaces signal institutions that can work for travellers. Hate-crime law is mostly orientation-based and enforcement undocumented, so it is only a climate signal. Negative factors: a documented 2019 prison placement failure with rape and custodial indifference shows severe state-custody exposure; former police raids, stalled conversion therapy and 2025 sex-ed rollback indicate conservative pressure. Border/airport and service data are absent, not safe, but no active visitor restriction is documented. Thus reduced-risk, above high-risk jurisdictions but below clearly operating visitor-protection anchors.
